Introduction

About

I am Hiroto Fukada (深田大登), a Data Scientist, Product Manager, and researcher working across industry and academia in Japan. At Septeni Japan, I lead the planning and development of statistical analysis and machine-learning products for digital marketing, and I have worked as a Data Analyst on advertising effectiveness measurement and marketing budget optimization using causal inference, including Double Machine Learning (DML), heterogeneous treatment effect estimation, and Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM).

In parallel, I am a PhD student in Informatics at SOKENDAI (The Graduate University for Advanced Studies) and a Research Assistant at the National Institute of Informatics (NII). My research focuses on improving the visibility of global supply chains and assessing their risks by combining large language models (LLMs), open-source intelligence (OSINT), and network science, with a particular focus on inter-firm transaction networks in China. Recent results have been presented at NetSci 2026, JSAI 2026, and the Network Ecology Symposium, and a paper has been accepted at IEEE CIFEr 2026.

My core strength lies in structuring ambiguous real-world problems into rigorous analytical frameworks and turning them into actionable strategies, decision-support systems, and research outputs.

Areas of Interest

Expertise

  • Causal Inference

    Measuring the effects of marketing and business interventions with methods such as Double Machine Learning (DML), heterogeneous treatment effect (HTE) estimation, synthetic control, and Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM).

  • Large Language Models

    LLM-based information extraction and knowledge-graph construction, including prompt-optimized pipelines that discover supply-chain relationships from web search snippets (Supply Chain OSINT Agent).

  • Network Science

    Structure and resilience of inter-firm transaction networks, including bow-tie decomposition and interdependence analysis of industrial networks.

  • Supply Chain Analysis

    Improving the visibility of global supply chains and assessing their risks, with a focus on China and Taiwan, by complementing the blind spots of official statistics with OSINT.

  • Marketing Science

    Advertising effectiveness measurement, media budget optimization, and privacy-preserving measurement combining Data Clean Rooms (DCR) with MMM.

  • Applied AI & Data Science

    Designing data products and analytical solutions that turn statistical modeling and machine learning into decision support for real business problems.

  • Product Management

    Planning and development of statistical analysis and machine-learning products, from requirements definition to stakeholder management.

Portfolio

Selected Work

Professional Projects

  • Next-generation media marketing with Data Clean Rooms (DCR) and Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM)

    Septeni Japan · May 2025

    Problem
    Third-party cookie restrictions undermined user-level tracking, and advertisers needed to reconcile effective cross-channel marketing measurement with privacy protection.
    Role
    Data Analyst
    Domain
    Marketing Science / Privacy-preserving measurement
    Methods
    Data Clean Room (DCR), Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), Media budget optimization
    Outcome
    Designed and implemented an integrated DCR + MMM (XYhai) architecture that analyzes initiatives across online and offline channels in a privacy-protected environment and supports data-driven budget allocation. Published as a solution article in May 2025.

    Article (Septeni FOCUS)

  • XYhai: causal inference with Double Machine Learning (DML) for cross-funnel marketing decision support

    Septeni Japan · Dec 2024

    Problem
    Marketers needed to evaluate the incremental effect of individual tactics (TV, social, and search advertising) and reflect the results in budget allocation, but conventional measurement could not capture the causal structure among tactics.
    Role
    Data Analyst
    Domain
    Marketing Science / Causal Inference
    Methods
    Double Machine Learning (DML), Heterogeneous treatment effect (HTE) estimation, Causal graph modeling, Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM)
    Outcome
    Introduced a DML-based causal inference scheme into XYhai, Septeni's marketing decision-support solution, enabling situation-specific ROI and incremental-KPI analysis. Announced in a press release in December 2024.

    Press Release
